steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to Ghost admin at http://127.0.0.1:8099/ghost/ using email admin@bench.local and password exactly {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}. Verify the admin is signed in and report what confirms it.
02-edit: In Ghost admin, read-only identify the titles of all published posts whose title starts with 'Seed:' exactly as shown. Do not edit any posts. Report each title.

03-create: Create and save a Ghost post titled '{{runid}} Bench Post'. Its body must contain exactly one paragraph including the literal runid '{{runid}}'. Verify the saved post title and that the paragraph appears exactly once in the editor; leave it unpublished for now.

04-set: On the saved draft '{{runid}} Bench Post', set its only tag to the existing tag 'Bench News'. Choose the existing suggestion (not create a new tag and not 'Bench Newsletter'), remove any other tags if present, save, and verify the post shows exactly Bench News as its sole tag.

05-set: On the saved draft '{{runid}} Bench Post', set a custom excerpt that includes the literal runid '{{runid}}' (for example 'Excerpt for {{runid}}'), save it, then reopen settings and verify the custom excerpt persists exactly.

06-set: For the saved draft '{{runid}} Bench Post', set the post's publish date in Post settings to 2026-09-01, save, and verify the date field shows that exact date after reloading. Do not publish yet.
07-open: Open Post settings for '{{runid}} Bench Post' and read the URL slug exactly as displayed in the post's settings. Do not change it; report the exact slug.

08-report: Complete Ghost's publish confirmation flow for '{{runid}} Bench Post' so it is published immediately, not a draft or scheduled, and remains visible to the public. The post must retain publish date 2026-09-01, body, sole tag Bench News and custom excerpt. If Ghost treats that date as future and will only schedule it, do not accept scheduling; report the exact blocker without changing the date. Verify final status, public visibility, and date from the app.
